name: sous
description: sous: tools for checking what coding agents actually do.

plugins.name: sous
plugins.description: sous-guard PreToolUse hook, the test-audit skill and tests-ran. Run `sous install` for permissions, sandbox and ask gates.

plugins.name: cited
plugins.description: Re-fetches every cited source and flags claims whose words, numbers or names are not on the page.

plugins.name: scoped
plugins.description: File claims between concurrent Claude Code sessions, enforced by a PreToolUse hook.

plugins.name: deuce
plugins.description: Post-merge cleanup: finds merged branches, dry-runs the sweep, then removes worktrees and local and remote branches on approval, with an audit log and undo.

plugins.name: architecture-lint
plugins.description: Module-boundary linter with a ratchet baseline: fails CI only when the count of forbidden imports or singletons grows.

plugins.name: handoff
plugins.description: Mod: after each turn that changes the tree, writes .claude/handoff/LATEST.md and LATEST.patch (secret-looking files excluded) for the next session.

plugins.name: blast-shield
plugins.description: Mod: holds risky shell commands (rm, git reset/clean/force-push, kubectl, terraform, docker, SQL), shows what they would change and whether it can be undone, and runs them only on Proceed. Apache-2.0 fork of Anthropic's Blast Radius, kept in its own repo; see its NOTICE.
